The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `7474` (see `Neo4jBuilder.Neo4jHttpPort`)
- Port: `7687` (see `Neo4jBuilder.Neo4jBoltPort`)
- Environment variable: `NEO4J_AUTH=none`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /` to port `7474` is completed successfully.
